comments: Submitted by the PaletteNest site maintenance team. This is an existing manual color-contrast calculator embedded in a publicly readable guide, at the linked calculator section. It checks two opaque sRGB colors and minimum ordinary/large text thresholds only; it does not crawl websites, process images/transparency, implement a documented ACT Rules report, or establish full WCAG conformance. The release date is the published date displayed on the page (29 October 2026); an earlier version history has not been independently established.
features: Free browser-based calculator for manually checking opaque sRGB text and background colors. Accepts hex inputs, shows the contrast ratio and WCAG 2.2 minimum-text threshold results, with 12 menu color presets and a live reading preview. Embedded in a guide; does not scan pages or certify site compliance.
title: PaletteNest Menu Color Contrast Calculator
